assumptions.text: Solid product ('furniture' family): moulded-shell checks (draft, undercut, wall thickness, clamp tonnage) do not apply; the measured checks are process fit, stock size and thinnest section on the product CAD
assumptions.label: estimate

issues.description: The part tolerance conflicts with the tighter CNC-panel tolerance, leaving the factory without a clear acceptance limit.
issues.fix: Issue dimensioned drawings that identify which features use the CNC tolerance and which use the general tolerance; define inspection datums.
issues.rule_citation: Specify feature-specific tolerances and datums on production drawings — ISO 1101.

issues.description: The fastener set lacks hole sizes, edge distances, insertion depths and an assembly sequence. Plywood joints may split or loosen if these are selected on the line.
issues.fix: Specify the hardware and pilot-hole pattern, verify edge distances and pull-out strength, and provide an assembly drawing.
issues.rule_citation: Verify structural strength and stability of changing units — EN 12221-1.

issues.description: The guard specification does not define installed height, continuity, attachment or gaps at joints, so the assembled unit cannot be checked for containment and entrapment.
issues.fix: Dimension the assembled guards and joint gaps; test the production assembly against the target-market changing-unit requirements.
issues.rule_citation: Changing-unit safety requirements and test methods — EN 12221-1 and EN 12221-2.

issues.description: The changing pad has no specified retention method and may shift during use.
issues.fix: Define a positive pad-retention method and verify it with the intended pad and finished deck.
issues.rule_citation: Changing-unit safety requirements and test methods — EN 12221-1 and EN 12221-2.

issues.description: Satin lacquer is listed as the foam pad's finish, but the wipe-clean cover material, seam construction and cleaning-chemical resistance are undefined.
issues.fix: Remove the lacquer callout from the pad; specify cover material, sealed-seam construction and a cleaning-resistance test.
issues.rule_citation: Define materials and finishes appropriate to foreseeable use and cleaning — ISO 12100 risk assessment principles.

issues.description: The anti-tip kit does not specify compatible wall types, fixing selection or installation instructions; supplying anchors alone does not ensure a secure installation.
issues.fix: Specify approved wall substrates and fixings, installation instructions and an assembled stability verification.
issues.rule_citation: Changing-unit stability and instructions — EN 12221-1 and EN 12221-2.

issues.description: Solid product (51.8 L of material): not an injection-moulded shell, so draft, undercut, wall thickness and clamp tonnage do not apply. Process: CNC routing of plywood sheet + edge finishing + flat-pack assembly.
issues.fix: Quote the listed process; send the STEP as the shaping / routing / layout file.
issues.rule_citation: Moulded-shell DFM rules apply to injection moulding only (Protolabs design guide)

measurement.label: measured
measurement.source_or_assumption: Solid volume of all parts, measured on the product CAD (build123d/OCCT)

issues.description: Largest panel 900 × 560 mm fits a 2440 × 1220 mm plywood sheet; nest all panels on as few sheets as possible.
issues.fix: Nest the CNC programme on full sheets; grain along the longest side.

measurement.label: measured
measurement.source_or_assumption: Largest panel length, measured on the product CAD (build123d/OCCT)

issues.description: Thinnest wooden part 16 mm: OK for screws and cam locks.
issues.fix: Keep structural panels ≥ 15 mm (18 mm birch ply); round every accessible edge r ≥ 2 mm (child safety).
issues.rule_citation: Cam-lock fittings need ≥ 15 mm board; EN 12221 asks for rounded accessible edges — Estimate

measurement.label: measured
measurement.source_or_assumption: Smallest extent of the wooden parts, measured on the product CAD (build123d/OCCT)

certifications.applies_because: This is a freestanding changing table intended for infants, so it must meet the US changing-table safety requirements, including applicable stability, structural-integrity, and restraint requirements.
